text:
Now the sun is failing; sea and sky, at rest,
joined, conceal the distant shore;
a bird of metal breaks the air,
flying in voice as far as flight is denied.

Unhappy child of African soil,
stolen from the harshness of the chain,
today you make music betray your sorrow
(if sorrow can exist where comfort is found).

Let your voice sound, though less than mine, captive,
for your trumpet follows the oar,
and you alternate groaning with song.

While I, condemned to Venus' sea,
pass from one extreme of love to another,
and, because it would ease me, even tears are denied.

translation.title: Hearing at Sea
